text: I'd like you to make a video of a realistic little wooden cabin among pine trees at dawn. I've had this kind of scene in my head for a while, and I'm curious to see it brought to life. What I mean is a silent, 6-second widescreen video, with the whole thing done as one shot slowly pushing toward the front door. I always worry that describing camera movement in words makes it sound more complicated than I actually mean. Keep a few trees in the foreground so you can feel the camera moving.
